name: sanad
description: Sanad: professional talent platform (منصة ربط الكفاءات المهنية)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sanad/shared && npm run build -w @sanad/api && npm run build -w @sanad/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint -w @sanad/shared -w @sanad/api -w @sanad/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @sanad/api -w @sanad/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @sanad/shared -w @sanad/api -w @sanad/web
